_comment: Who may answer a Crash Cart report. Three places need this list and none of them can import the others: core/role-capabilities.js (ES modules, crashCart.operate), firestore.rules (its own language, crashCartOperator), and the Cloud Functions (CommonJS). They drifted — the rules omitted three roles until a pharmacy staff member was refused on save, and the functions still omitted the outpatient supervisor. This file is the authority; tests/crash-cart-operator-roles.test.js fails the build if any of the three disagrees with it.
